text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I visited a shrine to help Espoir City refresh her mind, since she's been feeling a bit off lately, but...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...H-Hey. Do you hear that?
Like a cicada buzzing... or something...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under the eaves of the shrine, there was a mother cat crouching down with an injured leg,
and a kitten beside her, meowing nonstop.

text_block_list.name: Kitten
text_block_list.text: Two, two...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
! This little guy, don't tell me...
he's been doing this all along just to help his mom...!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, help me get them to the hospital!
...You're gonna be okay.
I swear I'm gonna save you guys...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days after that.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I heard about the rescued kittens.
They've gotten all healthy again, right?
Man, what a relief!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That's true, but...
...Well, you know...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
How do you even look for foster parents?!
I made flyers and stuff, but isn't there
anything else we can do...?!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, if that's the case, leave it to me♪
For now, should we try posting it on social media?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
My friends from Funabashi said they'd help out
with finding foster parents too.
...Don't worry, we'll definitely find them.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...My bad. I owe you one.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Espon, Espon!
We might be able to do something about that matter!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
! Whoa, whoa...!
Are you serious!?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Yep! Someone wants to get a new cat and take in a kitten.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...!
Just... kittens...!?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
What a relief for now...!
I'm sure someone will take in the mother eventually—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hold on a sec!
...That's no good...!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Mother cat and kittens!
I won't accept anything less than keeping them all together!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: That little one won't leave its mama's side, and... if mama can't see the little one, she cries searching for it...! So, that's why—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Tear us apart?! I'll never let that happen!!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, ro~ger that! In that case,
should we try negotiating just like Espon said?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
True, it's happier when we do it together... isn't it?
Understood, I'll help too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...After that, a foster family was found that took in
both the mother and child, and Espoir City seemed
relieved, recovering her good form.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—Afterward, Espoir City and the others
looked for foster homes for the cats, but..."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Damn it, I can't find it anywhere!
...If that's how it's gonna be...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Praying to gods or whatever, let's just do it!
Take it, take all my fortune!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Espo-san! Your sentiment is admirable,
but your entire fortune is a bit much...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Shut up!
I'm not half-assing this either!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Finding a foster home for the cats took quite a while,
and worry prevented Espoir City from
getting back into top shape..."
